items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: That was a Carl Fisher. Carl Fisher. Carl Fisher method, that's right. The old drum method.

ctx.x: That was a Carl Fisher. Carl Fisher. Carl Fisher method, that's right. The old drum method. The old Carl Fisher method. The old stuff stuff One who used to give me ideas about different divisions of music was Bush Hall, trumpet player, like I tell you, we played with the Young Tuxedo Band. And he gave me different pointers about dividing different music. And then I studied my own self, you understand, take the methods and self-practice and just get the ideas, just come to you, listen to other bands play. Then…
When you were young, did you practice very much by yourself on the drums?
